title: Warm Wilted Wholesome Greek Runner Beans Spanakopita
description: A sweet and springy hangover cure Greek dish featuring runner beans, infused oil, and a traditional spanakopita form.
instructions: Infuse the olive oil with a few sprigs of fresh parsley and a pinch of salt by letting it sit for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic in the infused olive oil until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the runner beans to the cauldron and cook until they begin to wilt, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice, crumbled feta cheese, salt, and black pepper.
Place a layer of phyllo dough in the bottom of the cauldron, trimming it to fit.
Spoon the runner bean mixture onto the phyllo dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Continue layering the phyllo dough and runner bean mixture until all ingredients are used, finishing with a layer of phyllo dough on top.
Bake the spanakopita in the preheated cauldron for 25-30 minutes, or until the phyllo dough is golden brown.
Let the spanakopita rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
